posts.subject: Re:USB-C - dGPU | Lenovo Legion Pro 5 16IRX8
posts.author: Adriel_lenovo
posts.message_html:
Hi artemkos,

Welcome to the Lenovo Community!

I understand your question if the Legion Pro 5 laptop's USB-C port is connected directly to its dGPU in order to run an external monitor to its full potential. Please note that such schematics or documentation aren't available for public access. Though, you can check out its Hardware Manual here, or the Lenovo Parts Removal Videos page via this link for reference.

Otherwise, you can also visit any authorized service centers in your area for in-person assistance. Make sure to ask how their store, including their repair policy work first before you bring it in.

Best regards,
Adriel_Lenovo
